candidates: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:534 - Leftover debug logging at Error level dumps every batch's full ID list.. Each batch calls `r.log.Error` twice, and one of those calls logs the full `ids` slice. The same pattern is at lines 554/557 and 576/579. These calls also run when nothing is deleted, so every cleanup cycle writes Error-level entries for each annotation type and for tags, even on a healthy system. With large batch sizes (the test uses 32767), each entry carries tens of thousands of IDs. That floods the logs, sets off error alerting, and hides real failures. The `err` logged at 534/554/576 is always nil at that point. Remove these calls, or log at Debug level with only the counts.
